title: Jesus' Genealogy from Abraham to Christ
description: Matthew introduces his Gospel with a structured genealogy tracing Jesus' line from Abraham through King David to Joseph, the husband of Mary. The list is divided into three groups of fourteen generations each: from Abraham to David, from David to the exile in Babylon, and from the exile up to Christ. This genealogy emphasizes that Jesus is the promised Messiah and the son of David [ref:Matt 1:1-17|Matthew 1:1-17].
